Generated by `python3 scripts/make-fixtures.py`. `scan.pdf` embeds a deterministic, poorly compressed RGB image; `mixed.pdf` includes selectable text, an external link, and the same image; `text-vector.pdf` is text; `already-optimized.pdf` has only a tiny content stream; `multipage.pdf` has three mixed pages; `corrupted.pdf` is intentionally invalid. All content is synthetic.

`password.pdf` is `multipage.pdf` encrypted with Ghostscript (RC4-128); the user password is `secret`.
`long.pdf` is `multipage.pdf` five times (15 pages) for the split-and-merge path.
`gray-scan.pdf` is `scan.pdf` converted to grayscale, for the black-and-white suggestion.

`scanned-text.pdf` (one image-only page with real words) and `mixed-scan.pdf` (a typed page, then that scan) are made by `node scripts/make-ocr-fixtures.mjs` for the OCR path.
